name: What are the typical stages of a multi-room interior remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical stages of a multi-room interior remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full-scope multi-room renovation involves several coordinated phases, beginning with site protection and selective demolition. Once the space is cleared, crews tackle custom framing and coordinate licensed sub-trades for electrical and plumbing rough-ins. Next comes hanging, taping, and texturing drywall, followed by tile or marble installations in wet areas. Finish carpenters then set molding, doors, and trim before interior painters apply finish coats. Working with a hands-on general contractor ensures finish trades coordinate smoothly without overlapping and causing site bottlenecks.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process follows demolition, framing, plumbing/electrical rough-ins, drywall, tile, finish carpentry, and final interior painting.
